tokens.name: color.semantic.dynamic
tokens.role: Use semantic system roles that adapt to appearance and hierarchy instead of freezing sampled RGB values.
tokens.notes: Role is more important than a captured value.

tokens.name: surface.hierarchy
tokens.role: Express view hierarchy with platform-appropriate backgrounds, grouping, and separation.
tokens.notes: Do not mechanically reproduce one platform surface treatment on another.

tokens.name: content.legibility
tokens.role: Choose size, weight, contrast, and wrapping for legibility under real accessibility settings.
tokens.notes: Accessibility behavior is part of the visual system.

tokens.name: interaction.agency
tokens.role: Controls should preserve user understanding, choice, and expected platform behavior.
tokens.notes: A behavioral design role rather than a visual constant.
